Crafting [[aether rune]]s offers relatively fast experience and can be profitable depending on the [[Grand Exchange]] prices. They are crafted by using [[soul rune]]s on the [[Cosmic Altar]] with [[aether catalyst]] in the inventory. Crafting aether runes requires level 90 Runecraft.

This method requires the following:
* Soul runes and aether catalyst in the inventory.
* Level 82 Magic to cast [[Magic Imbue]] and [[NPC Contact]], runes for them (astral, fire, water, air, and cosmic), and the [[rune pouch]] to save inventory space.
** With completion of [[Lumbridge & Draynor Diary#Elite|elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary]] wear a [[Mist battlestaff|mist]]/[[smoke battlestaff]] and a [[tome of fire]]/[[Tome of water|water]], respectively, to save runes.
** The crafted aether runes can be used in place of a [[cosmic rune]] for the [[NPC Contact]] spell.
* [[Binding necklace]]s to ensure [[combination rune]]s are crafted 100% of the time.
* [[Colossal pouch]] (or [[essence pouch]]es up to giant) to carry more essence per run.
* Fast access to [[fairy rings]]. The fairy ring in the [[player-owned house]] and using the [[Construct. cape|Construction cape]] teleport is the best option.
** Alternatively, use the [[quest point cape]] teleport or the [[eternal slayer ring]].
** Completion of the elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary allows using fairy rings without a [[dramen staff]].
* Level 66 Agility for access to the [[Jutting wall (Zanaris)|shortcut]] in [[Zanaris]].
* A fast [[bank teleport]], such as the [[Crafting cape]] or a [[ring of dueling]].
* [[Raiments of the Eye]] set for extra profit (strongly recommended for this method).

Starting at the bank, use the fairy ring to Zanaris. Run south to the altar, going through the [[Jutting wall (Zanaris)|eastern jutting wall shortcut]]. Cast [[Magic Imbue]] and use soul runes on the altar to craft aether runes.

Break a [[binding necklace]] when it has 1 charge left. As the player will craft runes 3 times per lap, a binding necklace lasts for 5 laps. The best way is to unequip the necklace and break it while running to the bank. Alternatively, withdraw an extra necklace and break it while running to the altar.

Experience rates in the table below assume using the POH fairy ring with the Construction cape and [[Ring of dueling|rings of dueling]] to bank at [[Castle Wars]]. Expect lower rates if using worse teleports or having extra items in the inventory. The profit rates include the cost of teleports, [[NPC Contact]] runes (before level 99), and [[pure essence]]. At maximum efficiency, it is possible to gain up to 104,000 experience per hour at level 99.
